review_note: An urgent business restructure, Board and leadership reduction, regional review, £1.6m annualised cost savings and £0.35m exceptional restructuring cost accompanied a £4.18m adjusted operating loss. Gross margin fell four points to 55%, operations used £4.78m cash against £4.69m year-end cash, and additional debt and equity working capital had been raised; lower losses and a £3.56m order book provided limited contrary evidence. The disclosed restructuring was already public at cutoff and is excluded as a future target event.
